}}'''Tymoth''' is an [[Asha'man]].

== Appearance ==
He has red hair.

== Activities ==
He is under the command of [[Rodel Ituralde]] during the [[Battle of Maradon]]. He is sent by Ituralde to destroy all the [[Shadowspawn]] siege weapons, using [[Fire]] weaves{{Ref/book|13|21}}. He takes command of the Asha'man in [[Maradon]] when [[Deepe Bhadar]] was badly injured (so probably he is the second strongest channelers after him).

He and his men throw everything they have at the invading [[Trolloc]]s coming through Maradon's broken wall before they exhaust themselves and have to withdraw.{{Ref/book|13|21}}{{Ref/book|13|28}}

== Trivia ==
* Tymoth is named for Timothy Brown, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
